body.text: The Claw Fossil revives into Anorith, which evolves into Armaldo at level 40.

sections.heading: Playthrough Notes
body: Armaldo has strong Attack (125) and Defense (100), giving it an easy-to-understand role in a normal playthrough: survive a physical hit and hit back hard.
Give it reliable physical attacks and use it against opponents that cannot exploit its Water, Rock, or Steel weaknesses.
Usually the easier choice for a normal playthrough.

sections.heading: Strengths and Weaknesses
body: Strengths: High physical Attack. Good physical Defense. Useful Bug and Rock damage. Broad physical coverage through TMs in many games.
Weaknesses: 45 Speed makes it terribly slow. Weak to Water, Rock, and Steel. Special Defense is less impressive. Must reach level 40 to evolve.

sections.heading: Choice Context

body.text: Choose the Root Fossil for durability and recovery. Choose the Claw Fossil for faster, more direct physical offense.

body: Claw Fossil is usually more straightforward for a normal playthrough, but Root Fossil can be more useful if the team needs a defensive wall or recovery.
